from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,time
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
for variant in ['BOLAS','HATCHET']:
 evidence=base/('evidence-'+variant.lower())
 command=['bash','tools/testing/run-unattended-test.sh','--scenario-id','EXHAUST-RETURN-'+variant,
  '--generated-scenario-path','/home/ltlly/Code/nmslmod/CombatSolver-perf-20261001/.local/veryhigh-dop16/frozen-corpus/requests/dev-06-silent-boss-scenario.json',
  '--combat-solver-build-dir',str(base/'build-native'),'--headless-instance','exhaust-return-'+variant.lower()+'-20261007',
  '--timeout-seconds','120','--evidence-directory',str(evidence),'--cleanup-instance-on-exit','--exit-on-complete']
 started=time.perf_counter()
 with (base/('launcher-'+variant.lower()+'.log')).open('w') as log:
  result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 summary={'variant':variant,'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-started}
 (base/('summary-'+variant.lower()+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
 if result.returncode:
  print((base/('launcher-'+variant.lower()+'.log')).read_text()[-6500:],flush=True)
  raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 print((base/('launcher-'+variant.lower()+'.log')).read_text()[-800:],flush=True)

verificationScope.realActions: Two real native card plays establish return eligibility; continuous and fork-each-step mirrors agree.
verificationScope.orderedExhaustMoves: Both real cards moved into Exhaust in specified order; mirrored state compared.
verificationScope.capacity: Nine native DefendSilent cards leave one hand slot; native BeforeHandDraw and isolated turn-start hooks match complete predicted state/RNG and move snapshot.
verificationScope.oppositeOrder: Independent reversed-exhaust shadow produces opposite last hand occupant; rich history/full continuation differs.
verificationScope.fork: Sixteen serially created children resolve in parallel; each full state/history equals reference, with sequential second-generation Fork checks; parent and live stay isolated.

sourceFindings.conclusion: Return membership is a set, but resolution enumerates ordered AllCards; lifecycle fingerprint records pile type and position for pending returns.
Rejects unaudited pending card types/attachments individually; ThrummingHatchet is already safe. No blanket pending-return rejection.
Root and branch component checks include pending returning cards individually.
Existing certified Hatchet self-return remains zero across Fork; unaudited off-pile Bolas conservatively keeps unknown healing. Existing successful tests reused, not repeated.

limitations: Changing raw exhaust order does not prove identical production state keys: the pending lifecycle fingerprint also contains position.
Card.Pile and BeforeHandDraw are indirect exhaust-order observers; direct get_ExhaustPile inventories alone are incomplete.
Colorless GenerateAllCards references only establish a source candidate, not actual filtered generation reachability or a closed proof.
Fixture removes initial relics/powers and uses isolated next-player-turn hooks. It is not the original full combat, enemy turn, full draw, auto-preplay, Coordinator search, or deployment.
Actual native complete state/RNG compared; rich history compared across simulation lanes. No claim of all native history fields or every future action.
Diagnostic request timing and current working set are not complete Coordinator timing or process peak RSS acceptance.
No broader HP-recovery certification, production pruning, performance acceptance, or regression result added.

decision.pruningRule: Use a complete compliant victory and conservatively bounded future recovery to reject strictly worse battle-loss branches. Merge state only after a closed proof of all future observable behavior; keep order-sensitive slots and unknown sources.
